claims: Team USA will face either Venezuela or Italy in the 2026 World Baseball Classic final.
Team USA defeated the Dominican Republic 2-1 in the semifinal.
Paul Skenes and Mason Miller provided strong pitching for Team USA in the semifinal against the Dominican Republic.
The 2026 World Baseball Classic final is on Tuesday, March 17, 2026, at 8 p.m. ET.
The 2026 World Baseball Classic final will be broadcast on FOX.
The 2026 World Baseball Classic final is at LoanDepot Park, Miami.
Gunnar Henderson hit a solo homer in the USA vs. Dominican Republic semifinal.
Roman Anthony hit a solo homer in the USA vs. Dominican Republic semifinal.
USA Today pitchers held off a late surge in the ninth inning of the USA vs. Dominican Republic semifinal.
Venezuela faces Italy on Monday, March 16, at 8 p.m. ET on FS1 to determine the other finalist.
Japan defeated the USA 3-2 in the 2023 World Baseball Classic final.
Japan won the 2023 World Baseball Classic championship.
